messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: p50 latency increased from 120ms -> 420ms in us-east-1. Alert generated by latency-slo-monitor. Paging @carol_oncall
carol_oncall: On it. Any correlation to today's deploy? I see kernel fallback spikes in the logs.
alice: Yes, rollout 2026-03-17 v4.2.1 -> v4.3.0 started at 03:05 UTC. Canary passed locally but we started seeing sawtooth at ~15% traffic.
ben: Logs excerpt:
```
03:14:22 kernel_select.cpp: fallback to generic_kernel (latency regressed)
03:14:23 batcher.cpp: batch_window shrunk -> batch_size=1
03:14:25 prefetcher.cpp: evict_count=118, prefetch_thr=0.3
```
dave_sre: Mitigation attempt: flipping feature flag `runtime.optimized_kernel` -> `off` for newly routed canary groups. Pushing kill-switch now.
carol_oncall: Confirmed flip rolled out to us-east-1 and us-west-2 (groups 3-10). Monitoring p50 and 95.
alice: Early customer impact: small increase in latency and ~0.2% rise in 5xx for high-throughput routes. No major outages yet. If no improvement in 10m we will rollback the canary.
ben: Plan: hold rollout at current percentage, prepare roll back to 4.2.1. Support notified to watch for customer tickets.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-03-17-42. Bridge: https://join.redwood/incident/INC-2026-03-17-42. Pager acknowledged by carol_oncall.
carol_oncall: Assigning eng-runtime triage. dave_sre and ben, please take lead on mitigation/rollback handoff.
dave_sre: I'll stage rollback steps now. Quick rollback command for k8s:
`kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=runtime:4.2.1 -n redwood-prod --record`
carol_oncall: Thanks — holding open until p50 returns near baseline and 5xxs drop. Will update in 5m.
